name: Fenwick Desk
description: A pale white oak writing desk with a single slim drawer and straight, square-edged legs. The top is finished in a matte hardwax oil so it stays light and quiet rather than glossy, and the drawer front sits flush with no visible pull. It suits a small home office or a bedroom corner where you want the desk to disappear into the wall.
details: 120 cm W x 60 cm D x 75 cm H
Solid white oak frame with oak-veneered engineered top
One push-to-open drawer, 50 cm W x 35 cm D x 8 cm H interior
Finished with plant-based hardwax oil; wipe with a damp cloth
Assembly in about 20 minutes with the included hex key
Made in Lithuania

name: Larkin Writing Desk
description: A low-slung walnut writing desk with tapered, splayed legs and two drawers with slim brass pulls. The top has a gently bowed front edge and a warm, hand-rubbed finish that deepens as it ages. It brings a 1950s study feel to a home office and pairs easily with a leather or wool chair.
details: 130 cm W x 62 cm D x 76 cm H
Solid American walnut legs and frame, walnut-veneered top
Two drawers on wooden runners, solid brass pulls
Cable grommet at rear center
Lacquer finish; dust with a soft cloth, avoid direct sun
Made in Vietnam

name: Kessler Sit-Stand Desk
description: A reclaimed oak top on a blackened steel electric frame that lifts from sitting to standing with a quiet motor. The planks keep their saw marks and nail holes, and the exposed steel feet and crossbar give it a raw, loft-workshop look. It is built for long days at a screen and for people who like their furniture to show how it was made.
details: 140 cm W x 70 cm D; height adjusts from 71 cm to 118 cm
Reclaimed European oak top, 30 mm thick, sealed with matte polyurethane
Powder-coated steel dual-motor frame, 100 kg lift capacity
Four memory presets on the control panel
Top planks vary in grain and color; each desk is unique
Frame made in Taiwan, top finished in Poland

name: Soren Desk
description: A spare oak desk with a thin black steel frame and a single open shelf beneath the top. The oak is brushed and oiled so you can feel the grain, and the proportions sit low and calm, with nothing to distract from the work in front of you. It suits a quiet home office or a corner of a Japandi bedroom.
details: 120 cm W x 58 cm D x 73 cm H
Solid white oak top and shelf, 22 mm thick
Matte black powder-coated steel frame
Open shelf 110 cm W x 25 cm D for a notebook and tray
Oiled finish; re-oil once a year
Made in Portugal
imageQuery: oak desk black steel frame japandi

name: Juno Swivel Desk Chair
description: A rounded, chunky desk chair in cream bouclé on a polished chrome five-star base. The seat and back are one continuous curve, padded deep enough for an afternoon of calls, and the whole thing swivels and rolls with a soft, slightly groovy ease. It makes a home office feel less like an office and more like a 1970s den.
details: 64 cm W x 62 cm D x 78–86 cm H; seat height 42–50 cm
Polyester bouclé upholstery over high-density foam
Chrome-plated steel base with gas lift and soft casters
Weight capacity 120 kg
Spot clean with a damp cloth; no bleach
Made in China

name: Hale Task Chair
description: A no-nonsense task chair with a blackened steel frame, a breathable charcoal mesh back and a firm molded seat. The exposed bolts and matte finish give it a utilitarian workshop look without the bulk of a typical office chair. It is the one to pick if you spend serious hours at a desk and want support that does not fuss over styling.
details: 60 cm W x 60 cm D x 92–102 cm H; seat height 44–54 cm
Powder-coated steel frame, recycled polyester mesh back
Adjustable lumbar, seat height and tilt tension
Weight capacity 135 kg
Hard-floor casters included
Made in Taiwan

name: Vesper Velvet Desk Chair
description: A channel-tufted desk chair in emerald velvet on a polished brass swivel base. The back has vertical fluting that catches the light, and the armrests are capped in brass to match. It is a polished, slightly glamorous seat for a home office that doubles as a dressing room.
details: 62 cm W x 64 cm D x 84–92 cm H; seat height 43–51 cm
Cotton-blend velvet over high-resilience foam
Brass-finished steel five-star base with gas lift
Weight capacity 115 kg
Vacuum with upholstery brush; professional clean only
Made in China
imageQuery: green velvet office chair brass base

name: Tilde Desk Organizer
description: A low oak tray with a matte black steel divider that sorts pens, a phone, and a few cards into three open bays. The oak is left raw and oiled, and the steel sits just proud of the wood so the two materials read as separate pieces. It keeps a desk top spare and tidy without looking like office supply.
details: 30 cm W x 12 cm D x 5 cm H
Solid white oak tray, powder-coated steel insert
Three compartments; the widest holds a phone upright
Oiled finish; wipe clean
Made in Portugal

name: Sabi Woven Desk Trays (Set of 3)
description: Three nesting trays hand-woven from natural seagrass with a terracotta cotton trim along the rim. They corral mail, chargers and notebooks with a relaxed, collected texture that softens a desk full of screens. Use them together as a stack or scatter them across a shelf.
details: Large 30 x 22 x 6 cm, medium 24 x 17 x 5 cm, small 18 x 12 x 4 cm
Hand-woven seagrass with cotton binding
Each tray varies slightly in weave and shade
Keep dry; dust with a soft brush
Made in Vietnam

name: Ledger Monitor Stand
description: A solid walnut monitor riser with tapered legs and a shallow drawer that slides out on either side for a keyboard or notebook. The edges are softly rounded and the grain runs the full length, so it looks like a small piece of furniture rather than an accessory. It lifts a screen to eye level and clears the desk beneath it.
details: 56 cm W x 24 cm D x 11 cm H
Solid American walnut, oiled finish
Supports monitors up to 20 kg
Pull-through drawer 48 cm W x 20 cm D x 4 cm H
Made in Vietnam

name: Bramble Pine Pegboard
description: A knotty pine pegboard with turned wooden pegs, two small shelves and a cream cotton pocket for post and pencils. It hangs above a desk or inside a cupboard door and has the homely, slightly scuffed charm of a farmhouse kitchen wall. Rearrange the pegs as your clutter changes.
details: 60 cm W x 45 cm H x 2 cm D
Solid pine with a clear matte wax finish
Includes 10 pegs, 2 shelves and 1 cotton pocket
Keyhole hangers on the back; wall fixings included
Made in Poland

name: Linea Linen Notebooks (Set of 2)
description: Two A5 notebooks bound in washed linen, one sand and one soft blue, with a sewn spine that lies flat. The paper is a creamy, slightly textured 100 gsm that takes fountain pen without bleeding, and the pages are dot-grid so they work for lists or sketches. They look like something found in a beach house study.
details: A5, 148 x 210 mm; 160 pages each
Washed linen over board, thread-sewn binding
100 gsm FSC-certified dot-grid paper
Elastic closure and ribbon marker
Made in Portugal

name: Fête Patterned Notebook Set
description: Three A5 notebooks with bold, clashing covers: a magenta and tangerine wave, a cobalt leopard, and a lime-green check, each finished with a contrasting cloth spine. They are playful, loud and built to be stacked on a desk where more is more. The lined paper inside is heavy enough for markers.
details: A5, 148 x 210 mm; 128 pages each
Printed board covers with cloth tape spine
120 gsm lined paper
Set of three; covers do not repeat
Made in Spain

name: Aster Fluted Brass Pen
description: A weighty rollerball pen machined from solid brass with a fluted barrel and a polished cap. It has a geometric, slightly jewelry-like finish that patinas with handling, and the balance is heavy enough that writing feels deliberate. It comes in a black gift box, which is to say most people buy it for someone else.
details: 140 mm long, 11 mm diameter; 42 g
Solid machined brass, unlacquered
Takes standard Schmidt-style rollerball refills; one black refill included
Brass darkens over time; polish with a soft cloth to restore shine
Made in Japan

name: Halden Wool Desk Pad
description: A thick, pale grey wool felt desk pad with a stitched edge that softens the sound of a keyboard and gives a mouse a quiet surface. It lies flat without curling and keeps a desk top looking clean and considered. Pair it with the Tilde organizer for a calm, two-tone setup.
details: 70 cm W x 35 cm D x 4 mm thick
100% merino wool felt, naturally stain-resistant
Stitched edge; non-slip backing
Spot clean with cold water; air dry flat
Made in Germany
